data.title: Forged runic inscriptions on rocks – the publication of 1933
data.excerpt: A scan of the original printed publication of 1933 devoted to runic inscriptions on rocks. The inscriptions it records later proved to be forgeries.
data.metaDescription: A scan of the original 1933 publication on runic inscriptions on rocks, inscriptions that later proved to be forgeries. The complete booklet page by page.

children.text: We present a scan of the original printed publication of 1933, which is devoted to runic inscriptions on rocks. These inscriptions later proved to be forgeries.
